title: Victorian Museum Exhibit Configurator
description: The user curates a Victorian museum exhibit by positioning a corset behind a broken glass window display case. They adjust lighting color and intensity, rotate the corset on a pedestal, scale the window frame, toggle an environment map, apply a post-processing bloom effect, and finally capture a screenshot of their configured scene.
prompt: Create a single HTML file using Three.js r170 (via importmap from cdn.jsdelivr.net) that implements a Victorian Museum Exhibit Configurator. Load both GLB assets using GLTFLoader: place the Corset model centered on a cylindrical pedestal (a CylinderGeometry mesh with metallic material) and position the GlassBrokenWindow model in front of it as a display case frame. Set up a PerspectiveCamera at position (0, 1.5, 3.5) looking at the origin. Add OrbitControls with damping enabled. Create a ground plane with a dark wood-textured MeshStandardMaterial. Add ambient light (intensity 0.3) and one SpotLight aimed at the corset from above-right. Build a fixed HTML/CSS control panel (top-right, semi-transparent dark background, 220px wide) with these interactive controls: (1) A color picker input to change the SpotLight color. (2) A range slider (0.0 to 3.0, step 0.1) to adjust SpotLight intensity. (3) A range slider (-180 to 180) to rotate the corset around the Y-axis in degrees. (4) A range slider (0.5 to 2.0, step 0.1) to uniformly scale the GlassBrokenWindow model. (5) A checkbox to toggle an RGBELoader environment map on all scene materials (use a generated PMREMGenerator default environment). (6) A checkbox to toggle UnrealBloomPass post-processing via EffectComposer (threshold 0.6, strength 0.8, radius 0.4). (7) A button labeled 'Capture Screenshot' that uses renderer.domElement.toDataURL to open the render in a new tab. Each control must validate its parameter range before applying. The corset rotation slider must clamp values. The scale slider must reject values outside bounds. Use requestAnimationFrame for the render loop. Render through EffectComposer when bloom is active, otherwise render directly. Import all modules (Three, OrbitControls, GLTFLoader, EffectComposer, RenderPass, UnrealBloomPass) via ES module imports from cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/three@0.170.0.
